verdict.rationale: Together AI does not document a first-party natural-language interface for operating the platform. It does ship agent skills that teach a user's own coding agent to write correct Together AI code, plus a docs MCP server for live documentation lookup. Together with the scriptable `tg` CLI, this lets an AI-native user drive the platform indirectly through natural language via an external agent. Missing for 10: a native NL console or assistant for operating the platform, an MCP server exposing operational actions such as deploying endpoints or launching fine-tunes (the documented one is docs-only), and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
